title: ClearPath Tenure and the Handling Retention on Network and Server Deposit Credits
content:
The handling retention of a deposit credit, the Hardware Procurement deposit credit that returns the paid deposit of a Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, follows the client's ClearPath tenure: the whole months from the go-live date of its active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement to the credit day, a month completing only once the day of the month reaches the go-live date's day number.

| ClearPath tenure on the credit day | Handling retention | Network Equipment Order | Server & Storage Build Order |
|---|---|---|---|
| fewer than 24 whole months, or no active ClearPath agreement | the order type's handling fee in full | 35.00 | 75.00 |
| at least 24 and fewer than 48 whole months | half of the handling fee | 17.50 | 37.50 |
| at least 48 whole months | nothing | nothing | nothing |

The handling retention is retained from the deposit credit. The go-live date is the one on the client's ClearPath agreement whose status is active.

**Counting, worked (hypothetical dates).** An agreement live since 5 October of one year has 23 whole months on 4 October two years later and 24 on 5 October two years later; it reaches 48 whole months on 5 October four years after go-live.
